statement.text:
(a) Determine the topological slice genera of torus knots. In particular, does
the topological slice genus of a torus knot equal half the absolute value of
its maximal Levine–Tristram signature?
(b) Is a two-bridge knot topologically slice if and only if it is ribbon, if and
only if it is topologically homotopy-ribbon?
(c) Are the Casson–Gordon ribbon and topological sliceness obstructions [CG86]
complete for two-bridge knots?
(d) Can the difference between the smooth and topological slice genus of a
two-bridge knot be arbitrarily large?
